hypothesis: createReservationItems_ reads inventory levels with a plain list (no row lock) and then writes reserved_quantity as an absolute value computed from that stale read (MathBN.add(level.reserved_quantity, adjustment)). The cart-id lock in completeCartWorkflow only serializes completions of the same cart, so distinct carts racing on the same SKU can both pass the availability check and both write back stale counters. I expect that with several carts on two servers racing for the single SOLO unit, more than one order can be created (no_oversell) and/or the reserved counter diverges from the live reservation rows (reserved_matches_reservations). Using two servers and multiple carts increases the chance of interleaving.
